description: This file contains unit tests for the 'provider-request-config' module, testing various functions such as resolving request configurations, headers, policies, and merging overrides, primarily for an SDK or API client.

methods.name: resolveProviderRequestConfig
methods.description: Resolves and normalizes provider request configuration from input parameters, including headers, auth, proxy, and TLS settings.

methods.name: mergeProviderRequestOverrides
methods.description: Merges two provider request override objects, with the second one taking precedence.

methods.name: resolveProviderRequestPolicyConfig
methods.description: Resolves policy-related configurations, including base URL, capabilities, and headers.

methods.name: buildProviderRequestDispatcherPolicy
methods.description: Builds a proxy dispatch policy object based on the resolved request configuration.

methods.name: sanitizeConfiguredProviderRequest
methods.description: Sanitizes user-provided request override configurations into a runtime-ready format, checking for unresolved secrets.

methods.name: sanitizeRuntimeProviderRequestOverrides
methods.description: Validates that runtime overrides do not contain proxy or TLS settings.

search-terms: unit tests specific to provider request configuration
